spans.text: O Lukako, when we return to Akihabara, I shall buy you...

units.rawText: Er, no, I mean, I shall forge you a new blade, so please don't cry anymore.
units.displayText: Er, no, I mean, I shall forge you a new blade, so please don't cry anymore.

spans.text: Er, no, I mean, I shall forge you a new blade, so please don't cry anymore.

units.rawText: ...But even if it were identical, it wouldn't be the same as the original Youto Samidare...
units.displayText: ...But even if it were identical, it wouldn't be the same as the original Youto Samidare...

spans.text: ...But even if it were identical, it wouldn't be the same as the original Youto Samidare...

units.rawText: ...What do you make of this, Antonina?
units.displayText: ...What do you make of this, Antonina?

spans.text: ...What do you make of this, Antonina?

units.rawText: My comrade has contacted Green-Haired Loli at some point.
units.displayText: My comrade has contacted Green-Haired Loli at some point.

spans.text: My comrade has contacted Green-Haired Loli at some point.

units.rawText: It won't work. The sword isn't registered in the Oasis' databases. I can't fix items or neural clouds that haven't been backed up.
units.displayText: It won't work. The sword isn't registered in the Oasis' databases. I can't fix items or neural clouds that haven't been backed up.

spans.text: It won't work. The sword isn't registered in the Oasis' databases. I can't fix items or neural clouds that haven't been backed up.

units.rawText: I could make a copy, but...
units.displayText: I could make a copy, but...

spans.text: I could make a copy, but...

units.rawText: (Sob)
units.displayText: Sob

spans.text: Sob

units.rawText: But it just won't be the same.
units.displayText: But it just won't be the same.

spans.text: But it just won't be the same.

units.rawText: Well, good luck, you guys. Bye.
units.displayText: Well, good luck, you guys. Bye.

spans.text: Well, good luck, you guys. Bye.

units.rawText: (Sniffle) It's okay... Samidare is special... Even if it's broken, I'll still cherish it...
units.displayText: (Sniffle) It's okay... Samidare is special... Even if it's broken, I'll still cherish it...

spans.text: (Sniffle) It's okay... Samidare is special... Even if it's broken, I'll still cherish it...

units.rawText: However, his actions are not matching up with his words, because his tears show no sign of stopping.
units.displayText: However, his actions are not matching up with his words, because his tears show no sign of stopping.

spans.text: However, his actions are not matching up with his words, because his tears show no sign of stopping.

units.rawText: ...I'm sorry! I don't know how to make it up to you, Mr. Luka. According to prison rules, I should offer up my little finger.
units.displayText: ...I'm sorry! I don't know how to make it up to you, Mr. Luka. According to prison rules, I should offer up my little finger.

spans.text: ...I'm sorry! I don't know how to make it up to you, Mr. Luka. According to prison rules, I should offer up my little finger.

units.rawText: This Kimie shall also do a penance of a three-month fast while confined to the shrine grounds and pray for forgiveness every day.
units.displayText: This Kimie shall also do a penance of a three-month fast while confined to the shrine grounds and pray for forgiveness every day.

spans.text: This Kimie shall also do a penance of a three-month fast while confined to the shrine grounds and pray for forgiveness every day.

units.rawText: No, there's no need for that! It's not your fault, Erika-san, Kimie-san...
units.displayText: No, there's no need for that! It's not your fault, Erika-san, Kimie-san...

spans.text: No, there's no need for that! It's not your fault, Erika-san, Kimie-san...

units.rawText: Everything would have been alright if I hadn't used the "Seishin Zanma School" back then...
units.displayText: Everything would have been alright if I hadn't used the "Seishin Zanma School" back then...

spans.text: Everything would have been alright if I hadn't used the "Seishin Zanma School" back then...

units.rawText: (Whimper) I'd rather have been hit by that bullet than let the sword which Kyouma-sensei gave me get broken...
units.displayText: (Whimper) I'd rather have been hit by that bullet than let the sword which Kyouma-sensei gave me get broken...

spans.text: (Whimper) I'd rather have been hit by that bullet than let the sword which Kyouma-sensei gave me get broken...

units.rawText: ...It's all my fault... It's okay...
units.displayText: ...It's all my fault... It's okay...

spans.text: ...It's all my fault... It's okay...

units.rawText: ...I didn't think Lukako thought so highly of that sword.
units.displayText: ...I didn't think Lukako thought so highly of that sword.

spans.text: ...I didn't think Lukako thought so highly of that sword.

units.rawText: Even I can't bear to see these three lovely ladies continue reproaching themselves! ...Though Lukako's a guy.
units.displayText: Even I can't bear to see these three lovely ladies continue reproaching themselves! ...Though Lukako's a guy.

spans.text: Even I can't bear to see these three lovely ladies continue reproaching themselves! ...Though Lukako's a guy.

units.rawText: <size=40>That's where you're wrong, Lukako! The past CAN be changed!</size>
units.displayText: That's where you're wrong, Lukako! The past CAN be changed!

spans.text: That's where you're wrong, Lukako! The past CAN be changed!

units.rawText: I whip out my cell phone and hold it high.
units.displayText: I whip out my cell phone and hold it high.

spans.text: I whip out my cell phone and hold it high.

units.rawText: Indeed! With a D-Mail, we can change the present situation!
units.displayText: Indeed! With a D-Mail, we can change the present situation!

spans.text: Indeed! With a D-Mail, we can change the present situation!

units.rawText: I shall create a future where Lukako isn't hurt and Samidare isn't broken!
units.displayText: I shall create a future where Lukako isn't hurt and Samidare isn't broken!

spans.text: I shall create a future where Lukako isn't hurt and Samidare isn't broken!

units.rawText: ...Is it really okay to use D-Mails like that, Okabe?
units.displayText: ...Is it really okay to use D-Mails like that, Okabe?

spans.text: ...Is it really okay to use D-Mails like that, Okabe?

units.rawText: Relax, Assistant! This D-Mail is purely to avoid conflict between Lukako and the others!
units.displayText: Relax, Assistant! This D-Mail is purely to avoid conflict between Lukako and the others!

spans.text: Relax, Assistant! This D-Mail is purely to avoid conflict between Lukako and the others!

units.rawText: Unlike the matter of the antique PC, it won't cause any other incidents this time!
units.displayText: Unlike the matter of the antique PC, it won't cause any other incidents this time!

spans.text: Unlike the matter of the antique PC, it won't cause any other incidents this time!

units.rawText: And besides, can you bear to watch Lukako castigate himself?
units.displayText: And besides, can you bear to watch Lukako castigate himself?

spans.text: And besides, can you bear to watch Lukako castigate himself?

units.rawText: Please, Makise-san!
units.displayText: Please, Makise-san!

spans.text: Please, Makise-san!

units.rawText: The Demon Sword Samidare means more to me than my own life!
units.displayText: The Demon Sword Samidare means more to me than my own life!

spans.text: The Demon Sword Samidare means more to me than my own life!

units.rawText: Urushibara-kun...
units.displayText: Urushibara-kun...

spans.text: Urushibara-kun...

units.rawText: ...Alright, I understand! Honestly, why are you making me out to be the bad guy, anyway?!
units.displayText: ...Alright, I understand! Honestly, why are you making me out to be the bad guy, anyway?!

spans.text: ...Alright, I understand! Honestly, why are you making me out to be the bad guy, anyway?!

units.rawText: Send me the D-Mail, then, Okabe. As it turns out, I'm feeling kind of interested in them.
units.displayText: Send me the D-Mail, then, Okabe. As it turns out, I'm feeling kind of interested in them.

spans.text: Send me the D-Mail, then, Okabe. As it turns out, I'm feeling kind of interested in them.

units.rawText: If I tell Erika and Kimie of the past that Luka is a guest of the Oasis, we should be able to avoid this conflict.
units.displayText: If I tell Erika and Kimie of the past that Luka is a guest of the Oasis, we should be able to avoid this conflict.

spans.text: If I tell Erika and Kimie of the past that Luka is a guest of the Oasis, we should be able to avoid this conflict.

units.rawText: I expected nothing less of you, my comrade!
units.displayText: I expected nothing less of you, my comrade!

spans.text: I expected nothing less of you, my comrade!

units.rawText: "tell eri & kimi luka is friend" ...That should work for the contents, right?
units.displayText: "tell eri & kimi luka is friend" ...That should work for the contents, right?

spans.text: "tell eri & kimi luka is friend" ...That should work for the contents, right?

units.rawText: That should work. I've already told Hashida and Antonina to make the necessary preparations in the lab.
units.displayText: That should work. I've already told Hashida and Antonina to make the necessary preparations in the lab.

spans.text: That should work. I've already told Hashida and Antonina to make the necessary preparations in the lab.

units.rawText: Indeed! Now we can avoid all this sadness and bloodshed!
units.displayText: Indeed! Now we can avoid all this sadness and bloodshed!

spans.text: Indeed! Now we can avoid all this sadness and bloodshed!

units.rawText: They're reporting electrical arcs in the lab. Go ahead, Okabe.
units.displayText: They're reporting electrical arcs in the lab. Go ahead, Okabe.

spans.text: They're reporting electrical arcs in the lab. Go ahead, Okabe.

units.rawText: <size=40>Let us march toward a future where nobody is hurt, my comrade!</size>
units.displayText: Let us march toward a future where nobody is hurt, my comrade!

spans.text: Let us march toward a future where nobody is hurt, my comrade!

units.rawText: And as I press the Send button, the world before me turns upside down again.
units.displayText: And as I press the Send button, the world before me turns upside down again.

spans.text: And as I press the Send button, the world before me turns upside down again.

units.rawText: Demon Sword Samidare was more precious to me than anything.
units.displayText: Demon Sword Samidare was more precious to me than anything.

spans.text: Demon Sword Samidare was more precious to me than anything.

units.rawText: After all, it was the first thing that Kyouma-sensei gave me...
units.displayText: After all, it was the first thing that Kyouma-sensei gave me...

spans.text: After all, it was the first thing that Kyouma-sensei gave me...

units.rawText: Lukako cradles the broken sword as tears stream down his cheeks.
units.displayText: Lukako cradles the broken sword as tears stream down his cheeks.
